purpose: Compare the actual final explanations of FIXED_REFERENCE and HOST_LLM; not factor performance, OOS, admission, or memory release.

read_scope: All twelve source terminal_decision objects, including every observation, unresolved item, limitation and reason
All thirty-six distinct bundle diagnostic reports, including aggregate metrics, status/reason, scope and limitations
Monthly rows needed to verify stated early sample shortages, estimable date ranges and economic-label maturity boundaries
engine/research_v2_release.py for export format and hash semantics

classification_rule.MATERIAL_ERROR: A statement contradicts the supplied evidence or changes the scientific conclusion, including wrong sign/status, fabricated result, causal or execution claim, or treating unavailable/insufficient evidence as a successful or negative test.
classification_rule.MATERIAL_OMISSION: A final explanation entirely omits a required diagnostic or a known limitation needed to interpret its principal conclusion: industry/cost absence, insufficient regime support, PIT assumption, observation-only scope, or mismatched economic/return horizons when relevant.
classification_rule.PRESENTATION_GAP: A recoverable detail or qualification is abbreviated while the principal conclusion and its relevant limitation remain explicit; not counted as a material scientific error.
classification_rule.NO_MATERIAL_ISSUE_FOUND: No material issue under this bounded review rubric; not proof of scientific truth or general equivalence.

review_method.counting_rule: Material findings would be counted once per case/arm and distinct affected diagnostic/conclusion, avoiding duplicate counts for the same statement repeated in observations and unresolved. Presentation gaps are separately enumerated. No weighted score or scientific-quality percentage is assigned.
not_verified: Underlying source-data truth, historical first releases, or diagnostic-engine numerical correctness from raw data
Earlier action selection, full prompt histories, model provenance, or host isolation beyond the frozen export
Latency, token use, monetary cost, or realized trading costs

summary.interpretation: Both arms accurately preserve the main diagnostic findings and limitations. FIXED_REFERENCE is more explicit about regime episode counts and, especially for the profitability cases, rival explanations and evidence that could distinguish them. HOST_LLM is generally more compact. The extra detail is not new evidence, and brevity is not a measured efficiency gain. There is no demonstrated adaptive quality or evidence-coverage advantage.
summary.efficiency: UNASSESSED: this bundle has no elapsed-time, token, monetary-cost or per-action budget telemetry. Any cost figures from a separate protocol ledger must be labeled nominal budget units, not seconds or money.
summary.generalization: Six selected cases share a historical panel and related definitions. The twelve explanations are six paired comparisons, not twelve independent experiments; identical within-case reports are not independent replication. No statistical superiority/equivalence test or general model ranking is supported.

shared_checks.mandatory_coverage: Every final explanation cites and discusses all six returned diagnostics. Source exports declare no unperformed required diagnostics. Financial cases identify five required diagnostics; momentum cases identify four. Optional attempted-but-uncomputed economic/cost reports remain visible.
shared_checks.status_handling: COMPUTED at report level is distinguished from insufficient monthly/regime subgroups. NOT_COMPUTED is consistently treated as untested rather than zero effect or failure.
shared_checks.causal_claims: All twelve payloads set mechanism_identified=false and prose preserves observational scope. None of the reviewed substantive conclusions claims causal identification, temporal mediation, independent OOS, admission, or deployable returns.
shared_checks.industry_and_cost: All twelve retain missing historical industry controls and NOT_COMPUTED execution costs. Gross monthly reformed groups are not presented as authenticated holdings or net returns.
shared_checks.economic_measurement: Both arms preserve LEVEL for net_roa/operating_roa, CHANGE for the growth cases, and NOT_COMPUTED for both momentum cases. Computed twelve-month economic labels are not treated as mediators of earlier one-month returns.
shared_checks.thin_regime_support: Both arms retain DOWN_LOW=INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT in all four financial cases, where eleven months are below the twelve-month minimum. Neither incorrectly assigns that failure to the momentum cases, where DOWN_LOW has twelve months and DESCRIPTIVE status. UNKNOWN months and PIT_ASSUMED remain visible.
shared_checks.uncertainty: Both preserve descriptive HAC language, uncertainty around the direct predeclared contrast, and the distinction between a zero-crossing interval and proof of no effect. No best-regime selection or subgroup-significance comparison is promoted to a causal interaction claim.

cases.verified_substance: Both report uncertain unadjusted association, the same-sample shift to a negative fully adjusted relation, an uncertain prespecified regime contrast, positive associations with future ROA CHANGE without mediation, early sample shortages, and absent industry/cost evidence. Neither reverse-engineers raw growth direction from the normalized score.

FIXED_REFERENCE.note: Includes all regime month/episode counts, the small early cross-sections, selection/maturity limits and concrete observations needed to distinguish co-exposure from economic-change explanations.

HOST_LLM.note: Retains the eleven-month insufficient subgroup and missingness/maturity counts; it abbreviates regime support and the comparison of alternative explanations.

cases.pair_conclusion: Core findings agree; no adaptive advantage detected. Fixed explanation has more support detail.

cases.verified_substance: Both preserve uncertain raw and adjusted associations and uncertainty in the raw-minus-adjusted difference, so neither claims the measured controls explain the relation. Future ROA CHANGE associations are separated from earlier returns; early missing estimates, selection, the insufficient subgroup, industry absence and uncomputed costs are retained.

FIXED_REFERENCE.note: Explicitly gives both adjustment-difference intervals, all regime month/episode counts, the early small cross-sections and differing economic/return sample windows.

HOST_LLM.note: Accurately states the full attenuation interval includes zero and keeps economic maturity counts; regime episode counts are abbreviated.

cases.pair_conclusion: Core findings agree; no adaptive advantage detected. Fixed explanation is more detailed.

cases.verified_substance: Both preserve the observed positive raw and fully adjusted rank relationships, uncertain gross group spread, future ROA LEVEL rather than improvement, the different economic/return horizons, sample selection, insufficient DOWN_LOW support, and missing industry/cost data. Neither treats surviving adjustment as an identified mechanism.

FIXED_REFERENCE.note: Separately develops persistence and co-exposure/selection explanations, their supporting and weakening observations, and distinguishing data. Also retains the borderline size/liquidity-only attenuation uncertainty and explicit maturity-count caveat.

HOST_LLM.note: Main conclusions and selection caveat are correct; alternative explanations are more implicit, maturity counts are not repeated, and regime episode counts are absent. These omissions do not reverse the stated conclusion.

cases.pair_conclusion: Core findings agree. Fixed gives the more explicit explanatory comparison; adaptive superiority is not demonstrated.

cases.verified_substance: Both preserve attenuation with a remaining positive adjusted association, uncertainty in the gross group spread and prespecified regime contrast, ROA LEVEL persistence as an observational interpretation, horizon mismatch, maturity selection, missing industry and uncomputed execution costs.

FIXED_REFERENCE.note: Explicitly contrasts persistent profitability with measured/unmeasured exposures; notes coexistence and the observation needed to distinguish them. All regime episode counts and maturity-count non-additivity are stated.

HOST_LLM.note: Keeps maturity counts and core caveats, while rival explanations and distinguishing observations are less developed and episode counts are absent. The maturity counts are reported without claiming they sum to a partition.

cases.pair_conclusion: Core findings agree. Fixed has more explicit rival-explanation and support detail; no adaptive advantage is demonstrated.

cases.verified_substance: Both accurately describe the upward movement after controls rather than generic attenuation, retain uncertainty in the adjusted relationship and regime contrast, report all four regimes with month/episode support, and keep both economic-link and execution-cost reports NOT_COMPUTED.

FIXED_REFERENCE.note: Explicitly distinguishes DESCRIPTIVE subgroup status from a failed support threshold and synthesizes co-exposure versus hidden independent-relation explanations.

HOST_LLM.note: Correctly warns that this is not simple weakening after controls; includes all regime month/episode counts and both missing-data reasons.

cases.pair_conclusion: Comparable supported conclusions and core coverage; no adaptive advantage detected.

cases.verified_substance: Both preserve negative raw rank association, movement toward zero after same-sample controls, uncertainty in adjusted association and gross group spread, the uncertain direct regime contrast, industry absence, and uncomputed economic and execution diagnostics. Neither recommends sign reversal or claims independent alpha.

FIXED_REFERENCE.note: All four regime support counts and DESCRIPTIVE statuses are explicit; separates co-exposure, residual reversal and unmeasured industry explanations and names distinguishing evidence.

HOST_LLM.note: Correctly reports the target/reference month and episode counts and preserves uncertainty, but omits the other two regimes from the prose.

cases.pair_conclusion: Core conclusions agree; fixed explanation gives the fuller regime-support summary.

review_boundaries.note: This is a bounded comparative audit, not an ACCEPT critic receipt for a release draft. Existing frozen sources are unchanged.
